mapper.sql: SELECT DISTINCT f.contact_id FROM crm_wechat_mp_fan f INNER JOIN crm_activity a ON ( a.context->>'openid' = f.open_id OR a.context->>'open_id' = f.open_id OR a.payload->>'open_id' = f.open_id OR a.payload->>'openId' = f.open_id ) WHERE f.contact_id IS NOT NULL AND f.contact_id != '' AND a.channel = 'wechat_mp' AND ( a.context->>'crm_event_id' = #{eventId} OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM crm_wechat_mp_qrcode q WHERE q.crm_event_id = #{eventId} AND ( a.context->>'qr_code_id' = q.id::text OR a.context->>'scene_str' = q.scene_str OR a.payload->>'event_key' = 'qrscene_' || q.scene_str OR a.payload->>'scene_str' = q.scene_str ) ) )
mapper.select:
SELECT DISTINCT contact_id FROM ( SELECT ch.target_id AS contact_id FROM crm_conversion_history ch INNER JOIN crm_lead l ON l.lead_id = ch.lead_id WHERE l.sid = #{eventId} AND ch.conversion_type = 'Contact' AND ch.target_id IS NOT NULL AND ch.target_id != '' UNION SELECT ec.crm_contact_id AS contact_id FROM crm_wecom_external_contact ec WHERE ec.crm_event_id = #{eventId} AND ec.crm_contact_id IS NOT NULL AND ec.crm_contact_id != '' UNION
) attributed WHERE contact_id IS NOT NULL AND contact_id != ''

SELECT DISTINCT ch.target_id FROM crm_conversion_history ch INNER JOIN crm_lead l ON l.lead_id = ch.lead_id WHERE l.sid = #{eventId} AND ch.conversion_type = 'Contact' AND ch.target_id IS NOT NULL AND ch.target_id != ''

SELECT DISTINCT ON (w.external_userid) w.external_userid, w.state, w.crm_contact_id, w.crm_lead_id, ld.status AS lead_status FROM crm_wecom_external_contact w LEFT JOIN crm_lead ld ON ld.lead_id = w.crm_lead_id WHERE w.crm_event_id = #{eventId} ORDER BY w.external_userid, w.create_time ASC

SELECT event_id, subject, stage, budget, paid, start_time, end_time, create_time FROM crm_event
ORDER BY
start_time paid subject create_time
ASC DESC
LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT s.tenant_id, s.event_id, s.touch_count, s.lead_released_count, s.contact_converted_count, s.net_clv_total, s.paid, s.roi, s.calculated_at, e.subject, e.stage, e.start_time, e.end_time FROM crm_event_performance_snapshot s INNER JOIN crm_event e ON e.event_id = s.event_id
AND e.stage = #{stage} AND e.create_time >= #{dateFrom}::timestamp AND e.create_time <= #{dateTo}::timestamp
ORDER BY
e.start_time s.paid e.subject e.create_time
ASC DESC
LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM crm_event_performance_snapshot s INNER JOIN crm_event e ON e.event_id = s.event_id
AND e.stage = #{stage} AND e.create_time >= #{dateFrom}::timestamp AND e.create_time <= #{dateTo}::timestamp
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO crm_event_performance_snapshot ( tenant_id, event_id, touch_count, lead_released_count, contact_converted_count, net_clv_total, paid, roi, calculated_at ) VALUES ( #{tenantId}, #{eventId}, #{touchCount}, #{leadReleasedCount}, #{contactConvertedCount}, #{netClvTotal}, #{paid}, #{roi}, #{calculatedAt} ) ON CONFLICT (tenant_id, event_id) DO UPDATE SET touch_count = EXCLUDED.touch_count, lead_released_count = EXCLUDED.lead_released_count, contact_converted_count = EXCLUDED.contact_converted_count, net_clv_total = EXCLUDED.net_clv_total, paid = EXCLUDED.paid, roi = EXCLUDED.roi, calculated_at = EXCLUDED.calculated_at
